independence_evidence: Self-described print-only independent publication launched in 2012, sold and distributed from its own shop alongside its own films, zines and merchandise (https://sexmagazine.us/pages/about).
qualifies_reason: Independent print magazine with Issue #16 released March 2026 (Issue #15 September 2025).
what_it_is: A print-only interview magazine that profiles musicians, artists, writers, filmmakers and internet personalities on the edge of pop culture through long conversations and portrait photography; despite the name it is not about sex. Issue 16 leads with John Maus and includes Dennis Cooper, Shlohmo and James Frey. It is for readers who follow underground music, art and online subcultures.
